a07.date.line: Data date: {d} (updates after the 15:30 Beijing-time close)
a07.date.unknown: Data date: unknown (the API returned no valid date)
a07.banner.stale: This list is based on the close of {d}. It is not an intraday signal.
a07.banner.before_close: Today's ({today}) candle has not closed yet; it updates after 15:30 Beijing time. Half-day intraday data must not be used for decisions.
a07.banner.after_close: It is past 15:30 Beijing time but today's ({today}) data has not appeared: the market may be closed today, or the after-close update may not have finished.
a07.banner.weekend: Today ({today}) is a weekend and the A-share market is closed; the latest list is from the previous trading day.
a07.banner.intraday: The data date is today ({d}) but it is not yet 15:30 Beijing time: this candle may be half-day intraday data, so do not treat it as a closing signal.
a07.banner.future: The data date ({d}) is later than today ({today}); the computer clock or the data may be wrong, so do not act on it yet.
a07.banner.unknown: No valid data date was found, so we cannot tell whether this list is current.
